text: Room business-brokers-ma-boutiques, label round 1: the listener was launched on Fable 5.1, but CLAUDE.md rule 13 (founder rule of 2026-09-27) requires Claude Opus 5.5 for every subagent and all bulk labeling. Script steps ran (harvest-search: 118 queries matched, 0 new records; batches: 896 records in 12 batch files). The existing taxonomy.json (13 pains) was reviewed against all 12 batches and left unchanged. No labels were written, and count/saturation were not run. Relaunch this room's label round on claude-opus-5-5 to write labels/batch_r1_001..012.jsonl.

Model policy changed by the founder on 2026-09-27: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) at max effort for everything, replacing the earlier strongest-available-model rule. Provenance: the pipeline build, Stage 1 (rooms), Stage 2 (mask, ladder audit) and the Stage 3 round-1 search plans ran on Fable 5.1; the search runners, which only paste queries into the search tool and judge nothing, ran on Sonnet 5 (round 1) or Haiku 4.5. Records are verbatim search titles and URLs, so they do not depend on the model. Every agent started after the switch runs on Opus 5.5 at max effort: agent definitions, skills and workflow scripts pin it.

Switch-over in Stage 3 (founder's message at 08:16 UTC): the five listening workflows already running were left to finish, as the founder asked. Under the new rule 13 the Fable labelers stopped themselves without labeling, including ones started before the switch (they re-read CLAUDE.md), so labels come only from Opus 5.5 unless a labeler already running at 08:16 finished normally (each room's source is logged when the workflows are resumed). On resume, finished search plans and searches replay from the workflow cache (searches return verbatim results, so the runner's model does not matter); labeling, later rounds and synthesis run on Opus 5.5 at max effort. Taxonomy drafts and partial labels left by Fable labelers that did not finish are removed first (they stay in git history), so Opus writes each room's taxonomy itself.

Settings: the repo-root .claude/settings.json now sets model claude-opus-5-5, CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=claude-opus-5-5 (plus the web-search cap). These apply to every Claude Code session opened at the repo root, not only this folder; remove them after the run if other projects should not use them. This host-managed cloud session ignores CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, so every agent is also pinned to Opus 5.5 by name.

Listener and walker instructions now keep temporary files in cache/tmp/<unit>/ (git-ignored), because parallel agents shared one scratchpad folder and could overwrite each other's helper files. Label writers check record ids against the room's batch list, so a collision fails loudly instead of mixing rooms.
Pipeline build verified: 426 tests pass (python3 -m pytest -q, 2026-09-27), after the 22 review findings were fixed with regression tests.

At 08:31 UTC the account's Fable usage limit was reached. Every Fable agent still running in the five listening workflows failed at once (label, plan and synthesize steps), so those workflows end early; their search runners (Sonnet/Haiku) finish their searches. No Fable labels were written after the switch. Each workflow is resumed on Opus 5.5 once it ends.
